label: O-1A — computational biology
text:
Re: Petition for Ester Vance, O-1A Beneficiary

Ester Vance has been recognized internationally for her contributions to computational biology. In 2021, Ms. Vance received the Windham Prize in Genomic Research from the Windham Foundation, an honor awarded to fewer than five researchers worldwide each year. Her work at Halden Bioscience Inc., where she led development of a novel RNA-folding algorithm, resulted in a licensing agreement valued at $2.4 million. Ms. Vance holds three patents assigned to Halden Bioscience and has published in Nature Methods and Cell Systems. She currently serves as Principal Scientist and will continue this role under the sponsorship of Halden Bioscience Inc. Receipt Number MSC-21-045-67890 confirms her prior H-1B petition, approved March 2021. She can be reached at e.vance@haldenbio.example for verification of employment.

label: O-1B — choreography
text:
Re: Petition for Julian Marsh, O-1B Beneficiary

Julian Marsh is a choreographer of extraordinary ability whose work has been staged by the Corvale Dance Theatre and the Aldric Ballet Company. In 2019, Mr. Marsh received the Tessen Prize for Choreographic Innovation, one of only two awarded that year. His piece "Undertow" grossed $180,000 in ticket sales during its Corvale Dance Theatre run and was later licensed to the Aldric Ballet Company for $45,000. Mr. Marsh will serve as Resident Choreographer under the sponsorship of Corvale Dance Theatre, receipt number EAC-22-198-33221, filed April 12, 2022. Correspondence should be directed to j.marsh@corvaledance.example.
